kicker: WanGP and YuE2, from the code

scenes.headline: How 6 GB of VRAM runs a 33B video model
scenes.sub: WanGP's block shuttle, and YuE2's two experts that never run together.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tadpole! A thirty-three-billion-parameter video model runs in six gigabytes. A three-billion music model asks for twenty-four. Here's why.

scenes.text: What a model needs in VRAM is set by where its weights live between uses. Keep a base and a two-block window; stream the rest.
scenes.say: VRAM is set by where weights wait between uses. Keep a small base and two blocks on the card, and stream the rest.

steps.say: The offloader splits a model into a base, which stays on the GPU, and a tower of blocks, which lives in system RAM.
Every block is wrapped in a hook. Before it runs, the hook checks whether it's on the card, and loads it if not.
While one block computes, the next is copied in on a second CUDA stream. One computing, one arriving.
WanGP's default budget is smaller than a single block, so nothing else stays. Just the base, and a two-block window.

scenes.title: MiniMax H3, one forward pass
scenes.note: offloading trades VRAM for time; no wall-clock is published
scenes.say: The saving isn't free. For MiniMax H3, thirty-one point seven in the checkpoint, two point eight one on the card, and thirty point one crossing PCIe every pass.

scenes.title: YuE2: two experts, never at once

steps.say: YuE2 is the mirror image. Each of its twenty-eight layers holds two equal experts, and only one runs at a time.

steps.note: writes a score and semantic tokens
steps.say: The autoregressive expert writes a score and semantic music tokens.

steps.note: offload_ar frees 4.03 GiB, and is off by default
steps.say: Then the other expert solves for the sound while the first sits idle. A flag moves it off the card, but it's off by default.

scenes.text: A VRAM figure describes a residency policy, not a model. Ask for the RAM, the card and the wall-clock too.

recap: A base plus a two-block window
The rest streams over PCIe, every pass
YuE2's idle expert could leave the card
scenes.say: To recap: a small window, heavy PCIe traffic, and an idle expert that could leave the card.
